check.language_note: The recorded ar query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Some submitted strings contain site. rather than site:; these literal strings are preserved and are not treated as domain-restricted searches. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. Preserved result batches, using 1-based positions in check.searches: JO-search = searches 1, 2 (en, ar). Each multi-query batch has only a combined returned result set; its source_ids cannot be attributed to individual queries. Historical query dates are recorded as 17 October 2026 in the phase6 search-boundary ledger.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The digital economy ministry identifies the 2020 AI policy, 2023-2027 national strategy and implementation plan, and national AI code of ethics.

record.notes: The ministry describes an AI strategy and implementation plan, a national AI code of ethics, and organisational readiness assessment for public-sector adoption. The strategy and implementation plan cover 2023-2027. Searches covered indexed public English and Arabic sources for a government-designated AI safety institute with a remit to evaluate advanced models.
